One Solver VISIT therefore makes 5 real distinct-seed contacts through the same metered request path a single Solver visit uses (seed = fragment_seed + seed_offset + sample_index, with fragment_seed 1249110493 derived once from this fragment's own policy id by rails.runner._solver_fragment_seed, so the five seeds are 1249110493..1249110497), and a Planner REVISE re-samples the whole group. rails.native_episode_config multiplies the Solver's own contribution by samples, so the bounded graph ceiling moves from the anchor's 1 + (1+1)*(1 + 3 + 1) = 11 to 1 + (1+1)*(5 + 3 + 1) = 19: policy phase-native-candidates-review-revise-samples5-v1 (max_contacts 19) and contact_cap 304 (4 rows * 19 contacts * (1 speech packet + 3 endpoints)). Every raw sample, its seed and temperature, its parse status and the delivered answer's support and tie-break provenance are sealed as a top-level solver_group sibling of native_episode_receipt in every outputs row; core.flight.runtime refuses to seal a declared-samples-at-least-2 row without it. KNOWN AND REGISTERED, not a defect of this fragment: agent states are registered per CONTACT, so the Reviewer and the Planner read the FIVE raw Solver samples as five separate kind=phase:solver states, not the one committed answer; the commit policy governs the DELIVERED answer only (proved by tests/unit/test_native_episode_runner_grouped_solver.py::test_grouped_solver_revise_resamples_and_the_reviewer_reads_every_raw_sample). native_episode.review_loop "on" is the E6 marker, a redundant checked declaration of the three role leaves that load_native_episode_config already requires to agree. Fold B is absent. The separate generation and native fit identities do not authorize contact. This is the four-row engineering SMOKE of the arm's form. It is the arm baseline configs/baseline/slurp-native-anchor-samples5-train-fold-a-v2.json byte for byte -- same policy fragment, same samples 5, temperature 0.7, seed_offset 0 and commit block, and DELIBERATELY the same speech-feature key and matcher identity, so the four rows render exactly the arm's own requests -- except its own native_contact_fit identity and the 4 rows * 19 contacts * (1 speech packet + 3 endpoints) = 304 endpoint ceiling, which core.preparation_fit.build_native_contact_fit_gate requires to equal rows * max_contacts * (packets + 3).
